notes:
Background: mid-market CX SaaS (user-facing in-app chat, search + embeddings). Started with Hosted API trial (Jan-Feb) to validate latency and UX. Hosted ingestion + embeddings looked promising but unit cost and variability in p95 latency drove interest toward Dedicated.

Summary of engagement: demo (hosted -> dedicated) 2026-02-10 with AE/SE. SE covered runtime, autoscaling, and routing policies. Pricing conversation 2026-02-24 (initial reserved capacity ranges). Customer requested a short Dedicated POC to prove predictable p95 + cost controls before procurement.

POC scope (accepted):
- Dedicated pool in us-west (2x A100 reserved equivalent) for primary traffic.
- Canary in eu-west routing 10% traffic for model variant evaluation and region failover testing.
- Model variants: primary = open-13b-ggml-8bit (latency-optimized), fallback = quantized-7b-4bit (cost/latency tradeoff). Also plan automatic fallback to Hosted small model (when Dedicated capacity saturated).
- Routing policies: latency-first for live support flows, cost-aware for async summarization. Canary policy to validate behavior and recovery.
- Rollback plan: automated fallback to previously stable model variant + manual rollback by SE if metrics cross thresholds for 5m.

Acceptance criteria / metrics:
- p95 latency (chat) <= 150ms under 200 rps sustained.
- Error rate < 0.5% for request+generation.
- Token cost <= $0.003/token for steady-state (target after batching/kv cache).
- Successful region failover with <30s user impact during controlled test.
